name: Hebei Jiuyuan Pipeline Mfg Co., Ltd.
nameZh: 河北玖源管道制造有限公司
description: ASME B16.5 flanges and B16.9 fittings manufacturer since 2010. Covers carbon steel, stainless, and alloy grades for ASME, DIN, and JIS standards. ISO 9001 certified.
descriptionZh: 成立于2010年，专业生产ASME B16.5法兰和B16.9管件，覆盖碳钢、不锈钢及合金钢，支持ASME、DIN、JIS标准，ISO 9001认证，产品出口全球。

name: Hebei Beifang Yizao Pipeline Co., Ltd.
nameZh: 河北北方一造管道有限公司
description: Established 2017. Specialises in stainless steel and carbon steel fittings to ASME, ASTM, DIN, and JIS standards. Active exporter to Europe and Russia.
descriptionZh: 成立于2017年，专注不锈钢与碳钢管件制造，支持ASME、ASTM、DIN、JIS标准，ISO 9001认证，主要出口欧洲及俄罗斯市场。

name: Cangzhou Xinguangde Pipe Fitting Mfg Co., Ltd.
nameZh: 沧州鑫广德管件制造有限公司
description: Pipe fitting specialist — elbows, tees, and reducers. Exports to Europe, Middle East, Russia, and Southeast Asia.
descriptionZh: 专业弯头、三通、异径管制造商，产品销往欧洲、中东、俄罗斯及东南亚市场。

name: Hebei Shengtian Pipe Fitting Group Co., Ltd.
nameZh: 河北圣天管件集团有限公司
description: Group-level manufacturer with 25+ years in pipe fittings and flanges. Broad ASME and DIN product range for industrial and oil & gas customers.
descriptionZh: 集团型管件法兰制造商，成立于1998年，拥有25年以上出口经验，覆盖ASME、DIN全系列产品，服务工业及油气客户。

name: Hebei Huayang Steel Pipe Co., Ltd.
nameZh: 河北华洋钢管有限公司
description: Steel pipe and fitting manufacturer since 2005. BV-certified. Serves export markets with seamless and welded pipe products.
descriptionZh: 成立于2005年，BV认证，生产无缝管及焊管，兼做管件，面向出口市场供货。

name: Chaoda Valve Group Co., Ltd.
nameZh: 超达阀门集团股份有限公司
description: Established 1984 in Oubei, Yongjia — one of the region's best-known industrial valve makers. Produces gate, globe, check, ball, plug and special valves to API/ASME/EN/JIS standards, Class 150–2500, with WCB through alloy and stainless castings. Long export track record.
descriptionZh: 创建于1984年，位于永嘉瓯北，是温州地区知名工业阀门制造商之一。按 API/ASME/EN/JIS 标准生产闸阀、截止阀、止回阀、球阀、旋塞阀及特种阀门，Class 150–2500，材质覆盖 WCB 至合金钢与不锈钢，出口经验丰富。

name: BTL Valve Group Co., Ltd.
nameZh: 伯特利阀门集团有限公司
description: Founded 1998, headquartered in the BTL industrial park in Yongjia's Sanqiao/Oubei area. Broad range of gate, butterfly, ball, globe and check valves plus special valves, built to ISO/API/ANSI/DIN/JIS/GB standards, Class 150–4500, NPS 1/2"–56". Active exporter to the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Europe and the Americas.
descriptionZh: 创立于1998年，总部位于永嘉三桥/瓯北的伯特利工业园。主导产品涵盖闸阀、蝶阀、球阀、截止阀、止回阀及特殊阀门等，按 ISO/API/ANSI/DIN/JIS/GB 标准生产，Class 150–4500，NPS 1/2"–56"，出口中东、东南亚、欧美等市场。

name: China Baoyi Group Co., Ltd.
description: Wenzhou-based valve group with roots going back to 1983, known especially for safety and relief valves alongside a full industrial valve line (gate, globe, check, ball) for energy and process industries. Supplies API/GB-standard products domestically and for export.
descriptionZh: 总部位于温州的阀门集团，始创于1983年，以安全阀、泄压阀见长，同时覆盖闸阀、截止阀、止回阀、球阀等全系列工业阀门，服务能源与流程工业，按 API/GB 标准生产，兼顾内销与出口。

name: Jiangnan Valve Co., Ltd.
description: Long-established Wenzhou valve manufacturer (est. 1985) widely known in China's power and water industries — particularly for large-diameter butterfly valves, hydraulic control check valves and pump outlet protection valves for hydropower and water-conveyance projects, in addition to a general industrial valve range.
descriptionZh: 温州老牌阀门企业（1985年创立），在国内电力与水利行业享有较高知名度——尤以大口径蝶阀、液控缓闭止回阀及水电站/输水工程泵阀保护装置见长，同时生产通用工业阀门。

name: Lixin Valve Group Co., Ltd.
nameZh: 立信阀门集团有限公司
description: National-level valve group founded 2000, based in the Anfeng industrial zone of Oubei, Yongjia. R&D, production, sales and service of industrial valves to GB/API/DIN standards for petrochemical, power, metallurgy and water-supply projects; active in domestic and export markets.
descriptionZh: 创立于2000年的国家级无区域阀门集团，位于永嘉瓯北安丰工业区。集阀门研发、生产、销售与服务于一体，按 GB/API/DIN 标准生产，服务石化、电力、冶金及供水工程，兼顾内销与出口。
